description.value: Boomtown is an independent beer garden and burrito bar in downtown Victoria, built around locally-sourced Mexican-inspired food and a rotating lineup of BC craft beers on draught from breweries like Driftwood, Hoyne, and Whistle Buoy. The atmosphere is proudly unfussy, with a covered year-round patio that has earned local recognition as one of Victoria's best. Well-behaved dogs on leash are welcome on the outdoor patio, and the venue explicitly embraces cyclists with dedicated bike parking.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: wave at 65m; stands (12 spaces) at 83m; staple (8 spaces) at 95m; stands (12 spaces) at 96m. Total: 32 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms the business is an active, independent pub and beer garden in downtown Victoria. Bike parking is confirmed twice: the FAQ states 'we have lots of bike parking' and the footer tagline reads 'WALK • RIDE • DRIVE (we've got parking for butts, bikes and wheels)'. Vegan and gluten-free options are explicitly listed in the FAQ and on the food menu. A postal code discrepancy exists: OSM lists V8S 1V2 while the website consistently shows V8S 1B2; the website value is preferred. OSM carries no phone number, but the website prominently lists 778.265.9150.
